title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics across python/ts/go; parity fixes; v1.165.1
author: Aisha Malik
description: Motivation: Bring Python, TypeScript and Go SDKs to parity for auth and retry behavior, and improve streaming ergonomics across languages. This PR consolidates the auth token refresh/retry wiring, standardizes transient error classification, and adjusts streaming APIs for more ergonomic consumer patterns. Context: multiple customers hit inconsistent retry behavior between SDKs (ENG-2345) and streaming ergonomics differences caused integration friction (ENG-2350). Changes here unblock a patch release (v1.165.1) and lay groundwork for Dedicated customer test harnesses. Checklist: - [x] Unify auth token refresh hook and header injection flow - [x] Centralize retryable error classifier and default backoff policy - [x] Stabilize streaming consumer API signatures and add high-level helpers - [x] Add cross-SDK integration tests (mock server) - [x] Version bumps for python/ts/go packages - [x] Update CHANGELOG and release notes Breaking notes: no API surface-breaking changes for existing call patterns; streaming helpers are additive. Rollback: revert the bump commit and previous tag if any of the cross-SDK integration tests or customer canaries fail. See docs: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-2345 and internal notes in #sdk-infra. Testing summary is below.
commits: squash: consolidate auth retry wiring across SDKs
feat(python): implement token refresh interceptor and tests
feat(ts): streaming helper + typed events and retry classifier parity
feat(go): retry classifier + stream wrapper and docs
chore: version bumps to v1.165.1 across sdks
test: add mock server integration tests for auth / streaming
diff_snippets: sdks/python/redwood/auth.py: added TokenRefreshInterceptor with exponential backoff and jitter (60 lines)
sdks/typescript/src/streaming.ts: new highLevelStream helper that yields typed events, backwards compatible with old onMessage callback
sdks/go/auth/auth.go: replaced custom RetryIf function with shared retry/classifier used by python/ts
review_comments: Jonah Park: please ensure token refresh is idempotent when called concurrently; observed race in a previous attempt.
Aisha Malik: added a lock + double-check in python interceptor, and used singleflight pattern in Go; updated tests.
Elena Ruiz: CI flake on ts streaming integration, added extra wait for mock server warm-up and re-ran tests.
Samir Patel: Approved after verifying parity tests and reviewing backoff defaults. Recommended we document the default max retries in CHANGELOG.
QA (automated): integration tests passed against mock server v0.4.2; e2e canary started and reported stable latency under 99th percentile SLAs.
testing_notes: Added cross-language mock server that exercises token refresh on 401 and transient 5xx retries; added tests to assert headers propagated, no duplicated tokens, and streaming helper yields events in order. Ran canary against dedicated infra for 24h: no regressions observed. Load testing: 200 req/s sustained with similar p50/p95 latency to previous release.
release_notes:
- SDKs: unified auth token refresh and retry classification across Python, TypeScript and Go.
- Added high-level streaming helpers for more ergonomic consumer patterns (TS/Go/Python).
- Version bumps: python v1.165.1, typescript v1.165.1, go v1.165.1.
- Non-breaking: default backoff and retry counts standardized; customers relying on prior non-standard retry windows should verify if they used custom retry settings.
notes_for_ops: Canary run ID: canary/sdks/2026-02-18-01. If customers report increased 429 throttling post-release, reduce per-client burst size and verify routing policies. Ops should monitor token refresh error rate metric sdk.auth.token_refresh_errors and streaming dropped_event_rate for one deployment window after rollout.
merge_summary: Squashed and merged after approvals from reviewers. Release artifacts published for all three SDKs and tags created: python/v1.165.1, typescript/v1.165.1, go/v1.165.1.
post_merge_actions: announce: #sdk-updates channel and release notes updated
